lanes.rule: An application or ask that does not say its lane is not sent. A restricted grant (e.g. Hedera → Fork the First Artist dev team) is Lane B with the restriction written in team_budget.

rails_doc: Every way to give, tagged by lane. status: live | needs-shaka | researching | not-eligible. 'holds' says plainly who holds the money. Fees are the operator's own numbers as read on the dated 'verified' line; we never add a fee.

rails.verified: verified 2026-11-14 (PAYTO address read from page source)

rails.name: Ko-fi

rails.name: GitHub Sponsors

rails.fee: 0% from personal sponsors (GitHub pays the processing)
rails.verified: verified 2026-11-14 08:2xZ: github.com/sponsors/shakaleikaumaka redirects to the plain profile → Sponsors NOT yet enabled

rails.needs: only if Ko-fi is not used

rails.name: Giveth project page
rails.how: Zero-fee crypto donations to the orchestra on Ethereum, Optimism, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, Gnosis, Celo. Once 'GIVbacks Eligible', donors can win GIV and the project can enter future quadratic-funding rounds (none live today).
rails.holds: osoartist.eth if the form allows a recipient address; otherwise the project's own account-abstraction wallet (Shaka keeps the login)
rails.verified: verified 2026-11-14 docs.giveth.io/projectverification + /givbacks read 08:3xZ; no QF round live
rails.needs: Shaka signs in (Google), publishes with the paste-ready packet apps/needs-shaka-giveth.md, then applies for GIVbacks eligibility (public post from an org-owned account linking the project is required)

rails.name: Open Source Collective (fiscal host · fiat + invoices)
rails.how: A US nonprofit host (501(c)(6)) that receives card/bank/invoice donations for open-source projects and pays expenses out. Eligibility read 14 Nov: open-source software projects under an organisational repo with an OSI/FSF licence — or open-source-adjacent communities with ≥50 members and ≥2 past events. We qualify on both: Open-Source-Orchestra org repos (GPL-3.0) and the circle's ~40 musicians / 9 hackathon showcases.
rails.fee: 10% host fee on incoming funds (fixed; no setup/minimum/recurring fees) + payment-processor fees (Stripe/PayPal/Wise)
rails.holds: Open Source Collective (the host) holds the money; the circle spends it through approved expenses, in public
rails.needs: Shaka decides (2 admins recommended: Shaka + one circle member); packet apps/needs-shaka-open-collective.md

rails.name: Juicebox (on-chain treasury with a public ledger)
rails.how: A project treasury on Ethereum/Base/Arbitrum/Optimism where every payment and payout is on-chain and readable by anyone. Paying in is free; 2.5% leaves as a fee when money is paid out (returned as JBP tokens); launch ≤0.001 ETH per chain.
rails.holds: the project contract; its owner (ideally a Safe multisig, charter Phase 2) schedules payouts
rails.needs: circle decision on signers first (charter Phase 2); not before

rails.name: Drips (continuous funding to repos & people)
rails.how: Anyone can already fund any public GitHub repo on Drips; claiming our repos lets funds split monthly to maintainers and dependencies. Good for ENS/Filecoin-style Drip Lists that fund public goods.
rails.fee: no protocol fee stated in the docs intro; gas to claim
rails.holds: the claiming wallet(s) per repo (maintainers' own addresses)
rails.needs: Shaka (repo owner) signs in with GitHub to claim; optional

rails.name: Endaoment (donor-advised funds)
rails.how: Grants go only to US 501(c)(3) nonprofits (or international nonprofits via GlobalGiving). Not a fit until the orchestra has, or is hosted by, a 501(c)(3). Donors pay 1.5%; orgs pay $0.
rails.holds: Endaoment → the nonprofit's bank or USDC wallet
rails.verified: verified 2026-11-14 legal.endaoment.org/orgs + docs donor FAQ read 08:3xZ
rails.needs: a 501(c)(3) (or a fiscal host that is one) — none today

rails.name: Bank / invoice for grantors
rails.how: Grant programs that must pay a legal entity by bank transfer or against an invoice. Today the orchestra is an unincorporated circle; a fiat grant can land only with Shaka personally or through a fiscal host (see Open Source Collective).
rails.holds: Shaka personally (until a host or entity exists)
rails.needs: Shaka + a lawyer/accountant (US citizen abroad; Thai remittance rule) before accepting any entity-only grant

rails.name: Safe multisig treasury (charter Phase 2)
rails.how: A shared smart-account wallet (e.g. 3-of-5 signers from the circle) that would receive Lane B grants and publish every payout on-chain.
rails.holds: the signers together; no single person
rails.needs: circle members who want to be signers + legal/tax advice for Shaka (charter §Phase 2)
